info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel Specific Management API provides endpoints to retrieve information regarding channel-specific services, focusing on advanced voice services management. This API supports querying channels via a unique parameter, allowing applications to access tailored data directly related to specific service functionalities. Typical consumers of this API include banking and financial institutions looking to enhance their service offerings through detailed insights. Use cases involve monitoring and analyzing voice service performance and adjusting strategies based on channel-specific metrics.

get.summary: Retrieve the details of a specific advanced voice service.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about a specific advanced voice service identified by its unique resource ID. Use this to obtain necessary details for managing advanced voice services in your application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve advanced voice services management information for a specific channel, identified by its resource identifier RES-100045. It includes necessary parameters and configuration options that dictate the operation of the GET request.

200.description: Request completed successfully and response data provided.

GetChannelSpecificByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to advanced voice services management. It is a string that contains the request data.

GetChannelSpecificByParam1Response_200.title: Advanced Voice Services Management Response

voicePlatformId.description: Unique identifier for the voice platform.

ivrFlowId.description: Identifier for the IVR (Interactive Voice Response) flow associated with this voice platform.

supportedLanguages.description: List of languages supported by the voice platform.

items.description: Language code (e.g., 'en-US' for English, 'es-ES' for Spanish).

concurrentCallCapacity.description: Maximum number of concurrent calls that the voice platform can handle.

regionCode.description: Region code where the voice platform is deployed (e.g., 'US', 'EU').

recordStatus.description: Current recording status of the voice platform (e.g., 'enabled' or 'disabled').

version.description: Version of the voice platform software.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the voice platform.

GetChannelSpecificByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for the Advanced Voice Services Management GET operation. It contains details about the voice platform, its capabilities, and metadata regarding the response.

processingRegion.description: Region where the request was processed.
